## Quantitative evaluation

When ground-truth IHC for a subset of slides exists, compute SSIM and
Pearson correlation between the predicted and observed stain channels.
GigaTIME typical scores are SSIM > 0.7 and Pearson > 0.6 for trained
biomarkers; below 0.5 means the slide is out-of-distribution and the
prediction should be flagged in the REPORT.html caveat ribbon as
low-confidence.
